title: RetrievalRequest
description: Contract 1: The standard query format for issuing a retrieval request against any GraphRAG backend. Uniform request envelope regardless of the underlying backend (TigerGraph, Neo4j, LightRAG, etc.).

protocol.description: The protocol version identifier. Must be 'graphrag/1.0' for this version of the specification.

operation.description: The retrieval operation to execute. Selects the backend traversal/search strategy.

query.description: The natural-language query or search text to answer.

entity_hints.description: Optional entity names/IDs the caller believes are relevant, used to seed graph traversal.

depth.description: Maximum number of graph hops to traverse from seed entities. Bounded to [1, 10].

top_k.description: Maximum number of results (entities, chunks) to return per result category. Bounded to [1, 100].

filters.description: Optional attribute filters (e.g., entity_type, year range, category) applied during retrieval.

backend.description: Optional backend/graph identifier when operating in a federated or multi-backend environment. Omit to use the default backend.
